name: Elvira 2 XL
notes: The neutral labs Elmyra 2 in full, after its manual (v2.4, neutral-labs.com): the delay to 1.6 s, BITS and NOISE beside the SRR program, the mix saturation, OUCH's feedback loop and DIODE, both LFOs into cutoff, bite, choke, time, wave and mod, and an 8-step sequence per voice on the transport with CHRM scales (the steps are on each seq card). Not here: the programs that need more oscillators, the filter types, the reverb. Browser only.
